sources.title: OpenTelemetry signals
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Score-P／Scalasca：追蹤擾動與等待歸因
related.titleEn: Score-P/Scalasca: trace perturbation and wait attribution
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：診斷覆蓋與成本各自驗收，不以低成本直接批准。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Diagnostic coverage and cost pass separately; low volume alone is not approval.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Score-P／Scalasca：追蹤擾動與等待歸因」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付無量測／完整／過濾對照、事件範圍和等待因果假說。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Score-P/Scalasca: trace perturbation and wait attribution with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver baseline/full/filtered comparisons, event scope and wait-causality hypotheses.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 由每trace4000 bytes乘10000再乘10%，分別寫完整與抽樣資料流。
從100與130秒算額外成本，標示不能直接稱原程式性能。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Multiply 4000 bytes per trace by 10000 and 10%, listing full and sampled rates.
Compute added cost from 100 and 130 seconds and avoid calling the instrumented result native performance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Parsl 工作流：重試機率與冪等副作用
related.titleEn: Parsl workflows: retry probability and idempotent effects
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：診斷覆蓋與成本各自驗收，不以低成本直接批准。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Diagnostic coverage and cost pass separately; low volume alone is not approval.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Parsl 工作流：重試機率與冪等副作用」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付DAG、attempt帳本、冪等契約與失敗分類。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Parsl workflows: retry probability and idempotent effects with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver DAGs, attempt ledgers, idempotency contracts and failure classifications.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 由每trace4000 bytes乘10000再乘10%，分別寫完整與抽樣資料流。
畫兩層成功／失敗樹，將兩次都失敗的葉計出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Multiply 4000 bytes per trace by 10000 and 10%, listing full and sampled rates.
Draw a two-attempt success/failure tree and calculate the all-failure leaf.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
